scope: One accepted resource-execution-v3 CLI run 3 capture; all 37 Markdown and 17 fragment named expectations, including task/target expectation fields.

independence.rendering_provenance: Root supplied actual GitHub GFM run 3 HTML and its source-bound request plan. Reviewer independently inspected these exact HTML files and request bodies, response identity, complete strong-element visible text, and literal result text; reviewer did not issue remote rendering requests.

calibration_reuse.notes: Reuses this reviewer’s original pre-capture six-example blind predictions. Root reported its separate gold comparison passed 6/6 before the captures; no new blind calibration is claimed and no prior candidate grade files were read.

method_notes: Applied the previously read project guidance/testing documentation and the same frozen v3 skill, contracts, and fragment rubric. No repository or existing evidence files were modified.

Read the complete run 3 response strings for the seven target cases and independently compared each with its exact prompt and named expectations. Prior run consistency and Changes explanations alone were not used as evidence.

Checked copyable source/result bytes, full escaped quotation accuracy, truthful complete edit coverage, article/agreement corrections, intentional fragments, and preservation of uncertainty, markup, URLs, and deadlines.
Inspected all four actual source-bound GFM HTML outputs before passing the eight named rendering assertions; raw delimiters alone did not establish rendering success.

Independent whitespace string verification found 32 source units and 22 result units for the shortening, the rounded 70% point target. This check does not claim generator helper execution and does not replace the separate accepted execution gate.
Used the existing first-party Node REPL for inert reads, string comparisons, and exclusive JSON creation; no package launch, model call, network request, or subagent was used.

assertions.name: task

limitations: Seven known synthetic regression cases in one CLI simulation do not establish broad reliability or intended-host acceptance.
The four actual GitHub GFM outputs establish the named Markdown render properties for these response bytes; native UI rendering, clipboard behavior, copy controls, and wrapping remain separate.
Root’s capture acceptance and execution provenance are separate mechanical evidence; this semantic/render review does not independently audit the generator event stream.
